description_en: Queries a list of shift schedules in Operation Center
description_zh: 获取运维中心值班表列表
name: ListShiftSchedules

parameters.help_en: The keyword used to perform a fuzzy search on shift schedules
parameters.name: shift_schedule_name

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID. You can log on to the DataWorks console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner to view the ID
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云账号ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台，鼠标悬停至顶部菜单栏右侧的用户头像，查看账号ID
parameters.name: owner

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的条数，默认为10条，最大100条
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Minimum value:1. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码数，用于翻页。最小值为1，最大值为100，默认为1
parameters.name: page_number
